verdict.rationale: Better Stack’s evidence pack covers Slack/Teams/email/SMS alerting, an API with bearer-token auth, and an MCP server for LLM workflows, but nowhere mentions webhooks as a subscription mechanism for events (incidents, monitor status changes, etc.). Since webhook support is a standard, plausible capability for a monitoring/incident platform, its absence from all docs and probes means this axis is unmet rather than inapplicable.
